rows.notes: The study is a meta-analysis (title, Abstract, Methods: 29 published studies, 3130 Dra and 1303 CU observations pooled with log-response ratios and random-effects model). It reports no own experiment, survey or measurements, so Q1 is 'no' per the instructions and Q2-Q9 follow. For reference, the synthesis does find that under reclaimed-water drip irrigation Dra and CU decline with cumulative operation time (Dra 96.1% and CU 93.3% at <125 h falling to 64.2% and 58.1% at 375-500 h, Fig. 2), which matches the passage's content, but this is pooled secondary data, not a primary result.
